reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to host variable, which is used in URL construction at line 43 ('http://' + host + '/v1'). While isNonPublicAddress check exists, it only blocks known private IPs and does not prevent DNS rebinding attacks (hostname resolves to public IP initially, then attacker controls DNS to point to internal resource). Resolved sink value at line 43 is http://<user_input>/v1, which is attacker-controlled.

evidence.note: User param flows to host var, then to URL construction at line 43
